Why FIRE AMC CONTRACT IS IMPORTANT FOR YOUR BUILDING

Under Abu Dhabi Civil Defense regulations, all commercial, residential, and industrial buildings — including those in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain — must hold a valid Fire (AMC)Annual Maintenance Contract certificate for their fire alarm and firefighting systems. Only Civil Defense-approved fire fighting contractors can issue this certification. Firestone is an ADCD-approved fire fighting AMC contractor providing full compliance support, preventive maintenance, and Istifa certificate assistance across Abu Dhabi and Al Ain.

blocks.text: Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: What is a Fire AMC contractor?
items.a: A Fire AMC contractor is a Civil Defence approved company authorized to carry out the annual inspection, testing, and certification of a building's fire alarm and firefighting systems. Firestone is a Grade A ADCD approved AMC contractor operating across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and Al Ain.

items.q: What is included in a fire alarm maintenance contract?
items.a: A fire alarm maintenance contract covers scheduled testing of detectors, control panels, and alarm devices, fault diagnosis, and compliance documentation for Abu Dhabi Civil Defence — ensuring your system stays certified year-round.

items.q: What does a fire fighting annual maintenance contract cover?
items.a: It covers sprinkler systems, fire pumps, hose reels, hydrants, and valve networks — full inspection and preventive maintenance to keep firefighting infrastructure operational and Civil Defence compliant.

items.q: What is an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) in Abu Dhabi?
items.a: An AMC is a mandatory yearly service agreement for all commercial, residential, and industrial buildings in Abu Dhabi, covering inspection and maintenance of fire alarm and firefighting systems by an ADCD approved contractor — required to maintain a valid Civil Defence certificate.

items.q: How much does fire alarm maintenance cost?
items.a: Cost depends on building size, system type, and number of devices. Firestone's AMC packages start from AED 1,500/year — contact us for a free quote tailored to your property.

items.q: Do you provide fire AMC services near me in Abu Dhabi?
items.a: Yes — Firestone covers all areas of Abu Dhabi and Al Ain directly, with additional offices in Dubai and Sharjah for UAE-wide coverage.
